items.name: Cụ Rùa
items.note: It surfaces rarely in the lake, a living reminder of the city's old stories.

items.name: Rồng
items.note: It glides between the limestone islands that rise from the emerald water.

items.name: Trâu
items.note: It wallows in the cool mud between the terraced rice fields.

items.name: Sao La
items.note: It moves quietly through the dense forest, rarely seen by people.

items.name: Chép
items.note: It swims slowly in the river, reflecting the glow of the town's lanterns.

items.name: Ngựa
items.note: It grazes on the hillsides among the flower fields.

items.name: Chào Mào
items.note: It sings from a branch above the busy streets.

items.name: Cò
items.note: It wades in the shallow water, watching for small fish.

items.name: Xoáy
items.note: It runs along the beach with its distinctive ridge of hair standing up.

items.name: Dơi
items.note: It hangs from the cave ceiling and flies out at dusk to hunt insects.

items.name: Roucou
items.note: It coos from stone ledges and waits near café terraces for a fallen crumb.

items.name: Cigalou
items.note: It sings through hot afternoons from the tops of pine and olive trees.

items.name: Léon
items.note: It lounges in the shade of an old park enclosure and lets out a low rumble at dusk.

items.name: Rascasse
items.note: It hides among sea grass and rocks in the calanques, its spiny fins blending with the seafloor.

items.name: Stori
items.note: It nests on rooftops and chimney tops, clattering its bill above the canals.

items.name: Drac
items.note: It hides under logs and damp leaves in shady woodland, emerging at night to hunt small insects.

items.name: Osito
items.note: In the mountain forests north of Madrid, it forages for berries, roots, and insects before winter sleep.

items.name: Lince
items.note: In the scrubland and marshes near Seville, it stalks rabbits with silent, padded paws.

items.name: Ferreret
items.note: It carries its eggs on its back legs until they are ready to hatch in a cool mountain pool.

items.name: Canario
items.note: In the pine forests and ravines of Tenerife, it sings from low branches while feeding on seeds.

items.name: Pizza
items.note: Scavenges for food in the subway tunnels of New York.

items.name: Coyo
items.note: Roams the scrubby hills and canyons around Los Angeles.

items.name: Lucky
items.note: Dashes through desert scrub at dawn and dusk near Las Vegas.

items.name: Gator
items.note: Lurks in the freshwater lakes and marshes around Orlando.

items.name: Humu
items.note: Nibbles at coral and invertebrates on the reefs of Honolulu.

items.name: Jingba
items.note: A small lion-like dog with a rolling gait, bred for centuries to keep quiet company in Beijing's old palace courtyards.

items.name: Xiexie
items.note: These freshwater crabs scuttle along muddy riverbanks near Shanghai and are celebrated each autumn for their rich roe.

items.name: Jinsi
items.note: In the Qinling mountains near Xi'an, this blue-faced monkey huddles through snowy winters and eats lichen.

items.name: Huahua

items.name: Luci

items.name: Tombili
items.note: Often found dozing on warm cobblestones near the Bosphorus.

items.name: Caretta
items.note: Nests on quiet sandy stretches of the Mediterranean coast.

items.name: Peri
items.note: Grazes on the sparse grasses of Cappadocia's fairy chimney valleys.

items.name: Yunus

items.name: Pembe
items.note: Feeds in the shallow saline waters of the Gediz Delta near Izmir.

items.name: Lupa
items.note: This wolf roams the ancient hills that overlook the Tiber, where its kind once hunted freely.

items.name: Seppia
items.note: In the shallow lagoon waters, this cuttlefish drifts among seagrass and shifts its skin to match the shifting light.

items.name: Porcellino
items.note: This boar roots through the oak forests of the nearby hills, where wild pigs often forage at dusk.

items.name: Biscio
items.note: In the grassy embankments along the city's canals, this serpent basks in the sun and hunts for small prey.

items.name: Azzurra
items.note: This lizard clings to the sun-warmed limestone of the sea stacks, its blue scales blending with the Mediterranean sky.

items.name: Ajo

items.name: Tibu
items.note: It glides over the reefs near Cancún, filtering tiny plankton from the warm water.

items.name: Chapulín

items.name: Coati
items.note: It forages along the forest floor near Tulum, sometimes drinking from cool cenotes.

items.name: Xolo

items.name: Maying

items.name: Gamyu

items.name: Hoitun

items.name: Romer

items.name: Merlina

items.name: Bobby
items.note: A sturdy terrier with a long coat, it trots along Edinburgh's cobbled closes and grassy hills.

items.name: Nessie
items.note: It glides through the deep, dark waters of Loch Ness, surfacing only when the mist rolls in.

items.name: Buzz
items.note: It gathers pollen from rooftop gardens and canal-side wildflowers, returning to a hive tucked away.

items.name: Herdy

items.name: Buddy
items.note: This bear ambles through Berlin's green spaces, always curious about a dropped crumb.

items.name: Waldi
items.note: This dachshund trots along Munich's Isar river paths, nose low to catch every scent.

items.name: Hein
items.note: This harbour seal rests on a sandbank in the Elbe, watching ships glide past Hamburg's docks.

items.name: Kucki

items.name: Ludwig

items.name: Pon

items.name: Hachi

items.name: Fugu

items.name: Koukou
items.note: It hunts insects at dusk from a favorite perch among the ancient stones of Athens.

items.name: Kri-kri
items.note: It leaps between rocky ledges in the high gorges of Crete, always alert for the slightest sound.

items.name: Petros

items.name: Plakad

items.name: Chanee
items.note: It swings through the rainforest canopy near the coast, its morning calls echoing across the treetops.

items.name: Lipi
items.note: It practices the high school steps passed down for centuries in the stables of Vienna.

items.name: Murmeli

items.name: Gamsi

items.name: Marjan

items.name: Sardi

items.name: Galo

items.name: Faro

items.name: Rimau
items.note: Hunts deer and wild boar in the rainforest fringes that touch Kuala Lumpur.

items.name: Helang
items.note: Soars over Langkawi's mangrove shores, scanning for fish and crabs with sharp eyes.

items.name: Utan

items.name: Reiger

items.name: Lieve
items.note: Crawls over tulip leaves in search of aphids.

items.name: Eendje
items.note: Glides under the little wooden bridges of the village.

items.name: Bandit

items.name: Skaana

items.name: Wapiti

items.name: Smok
items.note: It slumbers beneath Wawel Hill, its warm breath mixing with the river mist.

items.name: Wiewi
items.note: It dashes along a branch in Łazienki Park, tucking an acorn into a hollow for the coming cold.

items.name: Foka

items.name: Paun

items.name: Pjega

items.name: Vilin

items.name: Saqr

items.name: Arus

items.name: Ramli

items.name: Belarj

items.name: Magot

items.name: Fanak

items.name: Puli

items.name: Fogas
items.note: A sharp-toothed fish glides through the reed beds of Lake Balaton as dusk settles over the water.

items.name: Mangalica

items.name: Merang
items.note: It patrols the waterfront at dusk, calling to its family with soft chirps.

items.name: Enggang
items.note: It perches on tall trees and tosses figs into the air before swallowing them.

items.name: Belacak
items.note: It skips across the mudflats at low tide, pausing to defend its burrow.

items.name: Kkachi
items.note: It hops across tiled rooftops in Seoul, watching the streets below with quick, bright eyes.

items.name: Galmaegi
items.note: It wheels over Busan harbor, crying out above the fishing boats that ride the morning tide.

items.name: Dwaeji

items.name: Bastet

items.name: Khepri

items.name: Sobek

items.name: Tokek

items.name: Ora

items.name: Chüeli

items.name: Näsli

items.name: Barry

items.name: Lev

items.name: Méďa

items.name: Jelen

items.name: Shqipe

items.name: Maknine

items.name: Hathi

items.name: Pikkie

items.name: Sher

items.name: Fia

items.name: Älgis

items.name: Perezoso

items.name: Mamag

items.name: Wardi

items.name: Chulengo

items.name: Orry

items.name: Khokhobi

items.name: Mee

items.name: Nimr

items.name: Kiwi

items.name: Ranita

items.name: Twiga

items.name: Lundi

items.name: Milia
